naga_siren_eelskin_custom.name: Eelskin
naga_siren_eelskin_custom.description: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within %radius% radius.

naga_siren_mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
naga_siren_mirror_image.description: Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
naga_siren_mirror_image.lore: Slithice, while being strong in her own right, is notoriously hard to track down.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note0: Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note1: Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note2: Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

naga_siren_ensnare.name: Ensnare
naga_siren_ensnare.description: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
naga_siren_ensnare.lore: The only way to escape the onslaught of a Slithereen is to never oppose one in the first place.
naga_siren_ensnare.scepter_description: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

naga_siren_rip_tide.name: Rip Tide
naga_siren_rip_tide.description: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
naga_siren_rip_tide.note0: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.
naga_siren_rip_tide.lore: A torrent from the Deep Ones crushes the defenses of the Siren's enemies.

naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.name: Song of the Siren
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.description: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.shard_description: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.lore: Slithice's powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.note0: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.cancel_description: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.note2: The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.cancel_custom_description: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.
